body_html:
Electricity flowing
  poetry never
been a
Popular Sport
so test your
inner ear
hear a squash
ball
containment
back and forth
bouncing off walls
of translucent
  surfaces
as lines turn
taking sides in
creativty based
on complete ignorance.

Poets have glimpses
a knack, moving
glimmers to make
sens of life
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
Found Poem from Paul Mandoon
